column2: Choose a Patron God

The gods of the Old World are many. You can choose one of them as your personal patron, and people will associate your rule with that god. Most choose the god of their own faith, or the god their family has always honoured.
Sigmar who founded the Empire, Ulric of the wolf and the winter, and Taal and Rhya of the wild places. Perhaps one of them should be my patron?
Myrmidia the Eagle of the South, merciful Shallya, and Manann the Lord of the Seas. Perhaps one of them should be my patron?
Morr the Lord of Death, wise Verena, and Ranald the Trickster. Perhaps one of them should be my patron?
I should consider the other gods.
